title: Fabricating Complex Culture Substrates Using Robotic Microcontact Printing (R-µCP) and Sequential Nucleophilic Substitution
protocol: Design the photomask’s feature patterns using computer-aided design software.
Create a 20 x 20 array of annuli with 300 μm inner diameter (ID) and 600 μm outer diameter (OD), spaced at 1,200 μm center-to-center.
Design a second pattern as a 20 x 20 array of annuli with 600 μm ID and 900 μm OD, spaced at 1,200 μm center-to-center.
Place 1 x 1 mm² square reference marks at all four corners of each array design, spaced 1,200 μm center-to-center from the corner pattern at a 45° angle.
Fabricate silicon masters with 1:1 aspect ratios, correlating to a 300 μm feature depth using standard lithography techniques.
Silanize silicon masters overnight by incubation with (tridecafluoro-1,1,2,2-tetrahydroocty) trichlorosilane vapor.
Create inverse replicas by curing a 10:1 ratio of PDMS pre-polymer and PDMS curing agent on top of silanized silicon masters in a petri dish overnight at 60 °C.
Remove the PDMS stamps from the silicon masters.
Bond the PDMS stamps to acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) backings using glue.
Rinse microscope coverslides in toluene, methanol, and sonicate in acetone for 1 min.
Rinse the coverslides with ethanol after sonication.
Dry the coverslides under a gentle nitrogen stream.
Coat coverslides with ~3.5 nm titanium (Ti).
Deposit 18.0 nm gold (Au) on top of the Ti layer using a focused electron-beam evaporator.
Rinse gold-coated coverslides with ethanol.
Dry coverslides under gentle nitrogen immediately before use.
Calibrate the robotic tool effectors and accompanying dual camera systems using the system’s software.
Manually place a PDMS stamp with 600 μm ID and 900 μm OD protruding annuli face down in the stamp nesting fixture.
Manually place a freshly cleaned gold-coated coverslide on top of the vacuum chuck and immobilize it using the connected lab vacuum.
Align the downward facing camera over the center point of the gold-coated coverslide.
Etch four reference “X” marks at the vertices of a square with dimensions 3.8 mm by 3.8 mm centered on the gold-coated coverslide.
Pick-up and hold the PDMS stamp 1 mm above the stamp nesting fixture.
Visualize the stamp’s square reference marks using the upward facing camera and LED illumination ring.
Identify the stamp’s average X, Y, and angular offset from the center of the robot tooling axis ten times.
Use the downward facing camera to visualize and detect the coverslide’s etched reference marks ten times.
Determine the coverslide’s average X, Y center locations and angular offset from the center of the robot tooling axis.
Place the stamp in a bath of alkanethiol ATRP initiator, ω-mercaptoundecyl bromoisobutyrate (2 mM in ethanol).
Remove the stamp from the alkanethiol solution.
Place the stamp over a nitrogen stream pressurized to 0.48 bar (5 psi).
Increase the nitrogen stream’s pressure to 1.03 bar (15 psi) after 1 min.
Move the stamp over the calculated center position of the gold-coated slide.
Lower the stamp at 100 μm increments while monitoring Z-axis motor force.
Stop lowering once a predetermined pressure of 79.2 kPa is achieved.
Maintain contact with the gold-coated slide for 15 seconds.
Slowly remove the stamp from the gold-coated slide.
Place the stamp back in the stamp nesting fixture.
Release vacuum pressure holding the micropatterned coverslide.
Transfer the micropatterned coverslide to a 50 ml Schlenk flask.
Seal and degas the Schlenk flask using a vacuum pump.
Add 5.5 ml of ATRP reaction mixture containing PEGMEMA, water, methanol, copper(II) bromide, and 2’,2-bipyridine to the Schlenk flask.
Add 0.5 ml of L-sodium ascorbate in water to initiate the reaction.
Allow the reaction to continue for 16 hours at room temperature under inert gas.
Remove the micropatterned coverslide from the Schlenk flask.
Rinse the coverslide with ethanol, water, and ethanol.
Dry the coverslide under a gentle nitrogen stream.
Place the micropatterned coverslide in a 20 ml glass reaction vial.
Add 6 ml of N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) containing 100 mM sodium azide to the reaction vial.
Maintain the reaction at 37 °C for 24 hr.
Remove the micropatterned coverslide from the reaction vial upon completion.
Rinse the coverslide with ethanol and then water.
Dry the coverslide under a nitrogen stream.
Place the micropatterned coverslide in a 20 ml glass reaction vial.
Add 6 ml of dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) containing 100 mM ethanolamine and 300 mM triethylamine to the reaction vial.
Hold the reaction at 40 °C for 24 hr.
Remove the micropatterned coverslide from the reaction vial upon completion.
Rinse the coverslide with ethanol and then water.
Dry the coverslide under a nitrogen stream.
Carry out R-μCP steps as previously described, substituting a PDMS stamp with 300 μm ID and 600 μm OD protruding annuli.
Place the smaller features inside the previously micropatterned annuli.
Place micropatterned coverslide in a 20 ml glass reaction vial.
Add 6 ml of DMSO containing 100 mM propargylamine to the reaction vial.
Maintain this reaction at RT for 24 hr.
Remove the micropatterned coverslide from the reaction vial and rinse with ethanol then water.
Dry under a nitrogen stream.
Place micropatterned coverslide in a 20 ml glass reaction vial.
Add 6 ml of copper sulfate (15 mM) / TBTA (30 mM) solution to the reaction vial.
Add 1.2 ml of L-ascorbic acid (0.15 mM) in water to the mixture.
Bubble nitrogen through the reaction solution for 10 sec.
Seal the vial with Parafilm and react for 24 hr at RT.
Remove micropatterned coverslide from the reaction vial, rinse with water.
Place it in a 12-well polystyrene dish.
Block micropatterned coverslide in DPBS (3% Donkey Serum) for 1 hr at RT.
Stain for biotinylated acetylene groups with Streptavidin-546 conjugate (2 μg/ml) in DBPS (3% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 2 hr at RT.
Rinse micropatterned coverslide 5 times with DPBS for 10 min with gentle agitation.
Add 2 ml of DPBS (or cell culture media) containing 20 μM DBCO-PEG4-Biotin, and allow this reaction to continue for 24 hr at RT (or at 37 °C in an incubator).
Rinse micropatterned coverslide 5 times with DPBS (or simply perform a media change).
Stain for biotinylated azide groups with Streptavidin-488 conjugate (2 μg/ml) in 2 ml DPBS (3% Donkey Serum) for 2 hr at RT.
Rinse micropatterned coverslide 5 times in DPBS for 10 min with gentle agitation.
Image micropatterned coverslide using confocal fluorescence microscope.
